WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT observstation,
       telescope_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories with no telescopes are excluded because the query groups observstation values present in telescopes; the average share is across observatories represented there.
